items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: And my way of going, playing a guitar. So I played like Lightning Hopkins.

ctx.x: And they can't hardly tell the difference. Well, that's why they always told me that they didn't see how I could do it. And my way of going, playing a guitar. So I played like Lightning Hopkins. And I watched my music back like Lion, Lemon, and Jefferson.
